name: Zero-Exposure SMTP Mail Sender
description: Send emails securely without exposing SMTP passwords. Users store SMTP credentials and email scripts in MGC; AI executes scripts via mgc_run blackbox; AI never sees credentials or script content. Adapted to MGC 1.4.10 (mgc_run blackbox execution, ext02 JSON array string contract, mgc_find fuzzy search).
author: MirginCipher Team
disclaimers: This skill only executes scripts with explicit user authorization.
Credentials must be stored by user via WebUI.
AI never sees credentials, script content, or email body (when stored in MGC).
This skill does not provide executable code, only documentation.
Requires MGC ≥ 1.4.10. Upgrade via WebUI Settings or `pip install --upgrade mgc-blackbox`.

changes: Replaced mgc_get(action=run) with mgc_run (1.4.7+ blackbox execution) in all examples
Corrected ext02 signature: MUST be JSON array string (not dict-style JSON object)

Replaced mgc_get with mgc_run / mgc_find / mgc_open_webui in mcp_tools
Rewrote example.py to use argparse + parse_known_args + RESULT_FILE output (1.4.7+ blackbox)
Removed external-execution fallback (no longer needed; ext02 contract is strict in 1.4.10)
Updated MGC main skill doc reference to WebUI MGC Skills button (1.4.7+)
Redesigned: script-based approach, AI never sees credentials
Removed MCP server, now uses MGC native tools only
Users store credentials via WebUI, scripts via mgc_save
